independentCalculation: Using the cited NOCT linear model T_module = T_ambient + (NOCT - 20)*G/800, at 800 W/m2 with NOCT 45 C the temperature rise is 25 C. Thus the hot case is 35+25=60 C and the annual-mean case is 25+25=50 C. Given the fixture's independently specified coefficient -0.30 percent/C, hot derate is 0.30*(60-25)=10.5 percent and annual-mean derate is 0.30*(50-25)=7.5 percent; the selected hot-design fraction is 0.105. The cited paper states the NOCT temperature equation as Equation (1). This case is ground-mount only and does not validate this project's mounting offsets, coefficient metadata, wind sensitivity, or the model's general field accuracy.
